title: 第15章 林间袭杀第16章 全灭
slug: 剑帝第6901章阴天子的悔意
lines: 正在快速奔走的孙冰并没有慌张，反而脑海清明，相当冷静，从容的分析目前的情况，对方最少八个人，人多势众，现在冲上去只有可能死路一条。
而且孙冰自己，刚刚已经有了一定的消耗，所以此刻不宜正面冲突，但是一直这样追赶的话，孙冰终归有力竭的时候，这就需要好好谋划了。
最好的办法莫过于下杀手，一想到这里，孙冰脸上一寒，目露杀意，虽然对方并不是抱着击杀他的念头而来的，但淬体丹对于孙冰来说，同样重要。
俗话说，挡人财路如杀人父母，阻人成道如杀人全家，若没有淬体丹的供给，那么孙冰的修炼速度会慢很多，一步慢，步步慢，最终最好的结果莫过于泯然众人矣。
更何况此刻孙冰的怀中还拥有刚刚获得的三十年份的朱果以及同样珍贵的练气丹，这两样东西更是孙冰修炼的基石，若他真的被擒拿，那么肯定保不住。
一想到那样的后果，孙冰目光之中的杀意更加浓郁，他已经废物了整整十年，此刻不允许任何人阻止他变强，当即脚步一点，整个人朝着身侧跑去。
对方虽然人多，可由于孙冰发现的早，所以距离相当远，更何况对方一群人分布在四面八方，每一处最多不过一两人，根本就不是孙冰的对手，以此各个击破，这一次的危机就能轻而易举的消散。
这一个方向有着一名身材瘦小的中年人，名叫张三，他本就是落云镇中的一个普通散修，可以说相当平凡，甚至连淬体丹的模样都没有见过。
看到了孙冰朝着他的方向跑来，目光中露出了浓浓的惊喜，要知道现在的孙冰对他们而言简直就是一个宝藏，只要能够拦住孙冰，最终他的功劳最大，能够分到的丹药也更多。
甚至张三的心中已经在那里幻想着，若是他独自一人将孙冰擒下，从身体上能够搜寻多少淬体丹，那是多么巨大的一笔财富啊，只要能够有那么一笔钱，甚至让他脱离卢健的队伍都行。
想着对于未来的美好幻想，此人的脸上满是狰狞，右手一把寒光闪闪的大刀，下手没有丝毫留情，显然想要杀人夺宝。
只不过可惜的他碰上了孙冰，脸色不变，当即右手一挥。
张三就感觉面前孙冰的木剑一闪，然后手上一股巨力传来，甚至虎口都传来了一阵疼痛，似乎已经崩裂了，还没有等他检查自己身上的伤口，就发现眼前一黑，脑中已经没有任何思维了。
虽然已经击杀了一个敌人，但是孙冰依旧没有任何放松，毕竟这才仅仅一人，后面还有最少七个人呢，再说，虽然对方境界比孙冰高，可战力实在是有些弱了，甚至连孙勇都比不上，实在没有什么成就感。
呼呼
一阵风声从背后传来，然后一道黑影瞬间朝着孙冰的背后袭来，仔细一看正是一支箭，奔袭的速度相当迅速，锋利的箭头闪烁着寒光，在林中露出森然杀机，朝着孙冰的后脑勺笼罩而去。
好箭法！好快！
孙冰的心中一凛，险而又险的侧身一闪，避开了那一道夺命的箭支，在鼻尖刮过一道冷风。
这可以说给孙冰提了个醒，虽然散修所学功法秘籍粗鄙，但是却有着两个极端，弱者极弱，宛若炮灰，而能够安然存在的必然有着自己的绝活，这些都是安身立命之本。
就如同这一道箭，孙冰能够肯定，若不是早就有防备，绝大多数人都挡不住这一箭，就算是孙冰也是险而又险，甚至现在背后还有一阵冷汗。
杀了一人再加上躲了一箭，别处而来的人已经逐渐接近，孙冰扫视一眼之后，立刻确定了新的目标。
正是刚刚发出那一箭的一名中年男子，对方似乎是落云镇中的猎人，所以对于弓箭相当娴熟，箭法高超，既然已经射出了这一箭，就代表着孙冰的敌人。
虽然弓箭远距离的威力相当强大，却拥有着致命的缺点，那就是近身战不行，恰恰相反，孙冰身为一个剑客，近战的攻击力令人惊骇。
看见了孙冰奔袭而来，那名弓箭手经验倒也相当丰富，立刻朝着自己的队友的方向跑去，毕竟他也深知自己的弱点。
可此刻的孙冰已经认准对方了，若不先把这一名箭法高超的人解决掉，那么接下来都得提心吊胆的，生怕在对敌的时候背后来一支箭，小伤倒也无所谓，万一涂毒了，那后果不可想象。
其实不仅仅是这一箭手，其余人也迅速改变了前进的方向，能在横断山脉中进出的散修，有几个是善茬？都是从人堆里面杀出来的，对于时机的把握相当在行。
这名精通弓箭的散修名叫李力，乃是附近有名的猎户，一手箭法相当出名，就算是普通人的时候，也曾机依靠陷阱机杀过最弱的二级妖兽，因为一次意外的机会，寻找到了他人遗留下的秘籍。
这才成为了一名修士，而且那秘籍也是关于箭法的，之后此人一手箭法更加的出众了，甚至可以说，自从他加入了队伍，猎杀妖兽以及别人的成功率都提升了很多，可想而知恐怖，本来以为那一箭孙冰根本无法抵挡，没有想到却失算了。
孙冰脚下生风，身如流星朝着对方扑去，不多时两个人的距离还真拉近了不少，不过此刻，也已经有着别人前来阻挡了，对方手中精铁利剑闪烁着寒光，直接朝着孙冰劈来。
对于这样粗浅的运用剑法，这让身为剑客的孙冰相当不喜，当即手中木剑如影随形，根本就不给对方丝毫反应时间，抓住了一个破绽，凌厉无比的剑光就已经略过了对方的身体。
血光乍现
一剑毙命
来不及查看战果，破风之声由远及近，那道熟悉的声音再次传来，很明显对方已经再次弯弓射箭。
只不过此刻的孙冰怎么可能没有防备，转身举剑，然后在众人惊骇的目光之中，木剑与箭头接触，硬生生的把这一支箭矢挡住了。
观察到了此刻的卢健甚至心中都已经有点发颤：这难道就是传说中一个大家族的废物么？一个废物怎么可能这么强？
要知道，自己队伍中的弓箭手他自己清楚，那绝对是一等一的，百米之内指哪打哪，在落云镇散修中可以算得上是赫赫有名了。
其箭矢的力道速度相当巨大，别人几乎还没有反应过来，就已经被射到了，即便反应过来了，也根本就拦截不了，甚至他自己，在没有防备的情况下，也是毫无办法。
可是今天看见孙冰竟然连续两次闪避开来，最后一次更是直接将箭矢拦截，这让他根本不敢想象。
不过很快，卢健就不由得摇了摇头，以前他又不是没有接触过家族的外门弟子，更何况自己手下还控制这三个子弟每月有三瓶淬体丹，这些人虽然战斗力比一般散修要强，但是经验欠缺，不足为虑。
“没有想到终日打雁终被雁啄瞎了眼。”卢健微微有些感叹，但却丝毫没有放手的意思，既然已经到了现在了，甚至还死了一个人，若停手议和，那就亏大了。
当即面色一狠，喊到：“都给我集中到一块，一起上，待会成功了今晚请你们好好潇洒潇洒。”
话音一落，自己也飞快的赶过去，现在他已经有些担心这些人解决不了孙冰，甚至已经打算亲自下手了。
content_en:
Sun Bing, who was running quickly, did not panic. Instead, he had a clear mind and was quite calm. He calmly analyzed the current situation. There were at least eight people on the other side, and there was a lot of strength. If he rushed forward now, he would probably die.
Moreover, Sun Bing himself has already consumed a certain amount just now, so it is not suitable for a head-on conflict at this moment. However, if he keeps chasing like this, when Sun Bing will eventually run out of energy, he will need to plan carefully.
The best way is to kill him. When he thought of this, Sun Bing's face turned cold and his eyes showed murderous intent. Although the other party did not come with the intention of killing him, the Body Tempering Pill was equally important to Sun Bing.
As the saying goes, blocking someone's path to wealth is like killing his parents, and blocking someone's path to enlightenment is like killing his whole family. Without the supply of Body Tempering Pills, Sun Bing's cultivation speed would be much slower, one step slower, one step slower, and the best result in the end would be to lose everyone.
What's more, in Sun Bing's arms at this moment, he also holds the thirty-year-old Zhuguo he just obtained and the equally precious Qi Training Pill. These two things are the cornerstone of Sun Bing's cultivation. If he is really captured, he will definitely not be able to keep it.
Thinking of such consequences, the murderous intent in Sun Bing's eyes became even stronger. He had been useless for ten years. At this moment, he did not allow anyone to stop him from getting stronger. He immediately stepped forward and ran towards his side.
Although there were many people on the other side, Sun Bing discovered them early, so they were quite far away. What's more, a group of people on the other side were distributed in all directions, with no more than one or two people in each place. They were no match for Sun Bing. By defeating them one by one, the crisis this time could be easily dissipated.
There is a thin middle-aged man in this direction named Zhang San. He is an ordinary casual cultivator in Luoyun Town. It can be said that he is quite ordinary. He has never even seen the appearance of the Body Tempering Pill.
When they saw Sun Bing running towards him, their eyes showed deep surprise. You must know that Sun Bing is a treasure to them now. As long as they can stop Sun Bing, he will have the greatest contribution in the end and can get more pills.
Even Zhang San has already imagined in his heart that if he captures Sun Bing alone and searches for as many body tempering pills as possible from his body, what a huge fortune it will be. As long as he can have such a sum of money, he can even get rid of Lu Jian's team.
Thinking about the beautiful fantasy about the future, this man's face was full of ferocity. In his right hand was a gleaming sword. He showed no mercy at all. He obviously wanted to kill people and seize treasures.
Unfortunately, he bumped into Sun Bing, his expression remained unchanged, and he immediately waved his right hand.
Zhang San felt Sun Bing's wooden sword flash in front of him, and then a huge force came from his hand, and even a pain came from the tiger's mouth, which seemed to have broken. Before he could check the wounds on his body, he found that his vision went dark and there was no thought in his mind.
Although he had killed an enemy, Sun Bing still did not relax at all. After all, this was only one person, and there were at least seven people behind him. Besides, although the opponent's level was higher than that of Sun Bing, his combat power was really weak, not even comparable to that of Sun Yong. There was really no sense of accomplishment.
Huhu
A gust of wind came from behind, and then a black shadow instantly hit Sun Bing's back. Upon closer inspection, it was an arrow. It was running very fast. The sharp arrow flashed with cold light, revealing a murderous intent in the forest, and it shrouded the back of Sun Bing's head.
Good archery skills! So fast!
Sun Bing's heart trembled, and he dodged sideways dangerously, avoiding the life-threatening arrow, and a cold wind blew at the tip of his nose.
This can be said to be a reminder to Sun Bing. Although the secrets of the exercises learned by casual cultivators are crude, there are two extremes. The weak are extremely weak and are like cannon fodder, while those who can survive safely must have their own unique skills. These are the foundation of a life.
Just like this arrow, Sun Bing can be sure that if he hadn't been prepared for it, most people would not have been able to block this arrow. Even Sun Bing was in danger, and there was even a cold sweat on his back.
After killing one person and dodging an arrow, the people coming from elsewhere were gradually approaching. After a quick glance, Sun Bing immediately determined a new target.
It was the middle-aged man who had just fired the arrow. The opponent seemed to be a hunter in Luoyun Town, so he was very skilled in bows and arrows and had superb archery skills. Since the arrow had been shot, it represented Sun Bing's enemy.
Although the power of bows and arrows from a distance is quite powerful, it has a fatal flaw, that is, it is not good at close combat. On the contrary, as a swordsman, Sun Bing's attack power in close combat is frightening.
Seeing Sun Bing rushing towards him, the archer was quite experienced and immediately ran in the direction of his teammates. After all, he was well aware of his own weaknesses.
But at this moment, Sun Bing has already identified the opponent. If he does not deal with this person with superb archery skills first, he will have to be on tenterhooks for fear that an arrow will hit his back when facing the enemy. A small injury does not matter, but if he is poisoned, the consequences will be unimaginable.
In fact, not only this archer, but the others also quickly changed their direction. How many of the casual cultivators who can go in and out of the Hengduan Mountains are good? They were all killed from the crowd, and they were very good at timing.
This casual cultivator who is proficient in bow and arrow is named Li Li. He is a famous hunter nearby. He is quite famous for his archery skills. Even when he was an ordinary person, he had the opportunity to kill the weakest level two monsters with a trap machine. Because of an unexpected opportunity, he found a secret book left by others.
Only then did he become a monk, and the secret book was also about archery. After that, this person's archery skills became even more outstanding. It can even be said that since he joined the team, his success rate in hunting monsters and others has increased a lot. It is terrifying as you can imagine. I originally thought that Sun Bing could not resist the arrow, but he made a miscalculation.
There was wind at Sun Bing's feet, and he rushed towards the opponent like a meteor. After a while, the distance between the two people was really close. However, at this moment, someone else had already come to block him. The fine iron sword in the opponent's hand flashed with cold light and struck directly towards Sun Bing.
As a swordsman, Sun Bing was not happy with such a crude use of swordsmanship. He immediately followed the wooden sword in his hand like a shadow, without giving the opponent any time to react. He caught a flaw and the extremely sharp sword light had already skipped the opponent's body.
A flash of blood
Kill with one sword
There was no time to check the results of the battle, the sound of breaking wind came from far to near, and the familiar voice came again. It was obvious that the opponent had bent the bow and shot arrows again.
But how could Sun Bing be unprepared at this moment? He turned around and raised his sword. Then in the horrified eyes of everyone, the wooden sword came into contact with the arrow and blocked the arrow abruptly.
Observing this moment, Lu Jian even felt a little trembling in his heart: Could this be the legendary waste of a big family? How could a loser be so strong?
You know, he himself knows that the archers in his team are definitely first-class. They can shoot wherever they can within a hundred meters. They can be regarded as famous among the casual cultivators in Luoyun Town.
The power and speed of its arrows were so great that others could hardly react before they were hit. Even if they did react, they would not be able to intercept them. Even he himself, without defense, was helpless.
But today he saw Sun Bing dodge twice in a row, and the last time he directly intercepted the arrow, which he couldn't even imagine.
But soon, Lu Jian couldn't help but shook his head. It was not like he had never come into contact with the family's outer disciples before, not to mention that his subordinates also controlled these three disciples to have three bottles of body tempering pills every month. Although these people were stronger in combat than ordinary cultivators, they lacked experience, so there was nothing to worry about.
"I didn't expect that I would be blinded by geese after hunting all day long." Lu Jian sighed slightly, but he had no intention of letting go. Since we have reached this point, and one person has even died, it will be a big loss if we stop to negotiate peace.
Immediately, his expression became fierce, and he shouted: "Gather them all together, and we will do it together. We will succeed later. Please have a good time tonight."
As soon as he finished speaking, he rushed over quickly. Now he was a little worried that these people couldn't deal with Sun Bing, and he even planned to do it himself.
